summary: App with data visualization and user profile features. Converting line graph to bar chart and fixing best streak calculation in profile section.
known_issues: Best streak in profile section incorrectly uses cumulative total instead of consecutive streak

existing_features.title: Convert the ProfileWinLossChart component from a line chart to a bar chart using Recharts. Replace the LineChart and Line components with BarChart and Bar components, keeping all existing filters (week, month, year, all-time), axis labels, tooltips, and color conventions (wins vs losses) intact.

Fix the best streak calculation displayed in the profile page's win/loss streaks section. The current implementation incorrectly uses a cumulative total instead of finding the longest consecutive streak of wins. Rewrite the logic to iterate through match history in chronological order and track the maximum number of consecutive days (or consecutive entries) with a win, storing the highest streak count reached.

new_feature_requests.summary: Convert line graph to bar chart
Fix best streak in profile to use consecutive streak instead of cumulative total
